commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
She goes on, for her friend to hear.

When I was apart from my lover and thought over his cruelties, my heart stayed here only to torment me as if devouring me. It wasn’t on my side. It took in his cruelties to make me suffer, not so that I could sulk with him over them today.
